ck_organization_members_dates.name: ck_organization_members_dates
ck_organization_members_dates.detail: left_at IS NULL OR left_at >= joined_at

ck_organization_student_enrollment_dates.name: ck_organization_student_enrollment_dates
ck_organization_student_enrollment_dates.detail: left_at IS NULL OR left_at >= enrolled_at

ck_subscription_plans_lifetime_duration.name: ck_subscription_plans_lifetime_duration
ck_subscription_plans_lifetime_duration.detail:
is_lifetime IS FALSE
     OR access_duration_months IS NULL

ck_billing_accounts_exactly_one_owner.name: ck_billing_accounts_exactly_one_owner
ck_billing_accounts_exactly_one_owner.detail:
(user_id IS NOT NULL AND organization_id IS NULL)
     OR
     (user_id IS NULL AND organization_id IS NOT NULL)

ck_subscriptions_access_period.name: ck_subscriptions_access_period
ck_subscriptions_access_period.detail:
(
         is_lifetime IS TRUE
         AND access_ends_at IS NULL
     )
     OR
     (
         is_lifetime IS FALSE
         AND access_ends_at IS NOT NULL
         AND access_ends_at > access_starts_at
     )

ck_subscription_students_dates.name: ck_subscription_students_dates
ck_subscription_students_dates.detail: removed_at IS NULL OR removed_at >= assigned_at

ck_student_login_challenges_issuer.name: ck_student_login_challenges_issuer
ck_student_login_challenges_issuer.detail:
(
         challenge_type = 'parent_qr'
         AND issued_by_parent_id IS NOT NULL
         AND issued_by_teacher_id IS NULL
     )
     OR
     (
         challenge_type = 'teacher_pin'
         AND issued_by_parent_id IS NULL
         AND issued_by_teacher_id IS NOT NULL
     )
